issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) requires calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (the number of remaining orders). The reference implementation in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java defines calculateRemainingOrderNumber() with a void return type (it prints order numbers instead). This mismatch between the specified API and the solution implementation can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification. Change SealSaloon.calculateRemainingOrderNumber() to return an int (e.g., return this.orders.length) and, if desired, keep printing as a side effect. Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to declare the method as void if printing-only behavior is intentional. Ensure the template (and any tests) use the same signature.
